proposed_laws.law: Normalize residues a mod m and b mod n. Let g=gcd(m,n), L=lcm(m,n). If (b-a)%g != 0 return CONFLICT(g,b-a), a positive gcd certificate of impossibility. Otherwise return unique canonical r in 0..L-1 with r% m=a%m and r%n=b%n and period=L. Signs normalized and arbitrary-width exact integers preserved.

falsifiers.why: Delta 1 is not divisible by gcd=2; a blind coprime CRT must not invent an answer.
Period must be LCM 8 not product 32.

proposed_laws.domain_boundary: Pure exact integer relation. Not a scheduler, timer, RF codec, phase-locked loop, FPGA ISA or D2 control law.
proposed_laws.uniqueness: D9 DIVMOD yields quotient/remainder for one division; D10 MODULO yields a residue; neither by itself specifies consistency of two constraints and a canonical merged period. However extended Euclid and arithmetic can derive this function, so Core-vs-library remains unresolved.
